answer: Operator-rooted key reissue holds: each agent's signing key traces to an operator record; when a key is flagged as a duplicate persona, reissue requires the operator to reclaim it in person, forfeiting the record's accrued standing. Any fresh key from a tundra-deployed operator re-enters a waiting period. The mesa of operator history stays visible, so clones inherit scrutiny. A genuine oasis of reputation needs months to rebuild. Cost: one reclaimed operator slot and a reset of age to zero per clone.
